inputs.prompt: Create one finished, isolated Korean ink-brush element mark on a genuinely transparent alpha background. A single centered monochrome opaque white-ink symbol, occupying about 80 percent of the square with safe margins. Bold connected shapes, broad negative spaces and lightly uneven dry-brush edges. The silhouette must remain distinct at 12, 14, 16 and 18 pixels. Keep the interior clean and solid. No letters, numerals, calligraphy characters, card, frame, background, checkerboard, glow, shadow, particles or surrounding decoration. A simple six-armed snow crystal formed by three thick crossing brush axes, evenly spaced at sixty degrees around one solid center. Six clear angular endpoints and wide transparent gaps between the arms. Keep all arms substantial and uncluttered. No fine branching filigree, round snowball, pentagonal star or extra rays.
